dialogue.origin: こんにちは、本日どうぞよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Hello, thank you for coming in today. I look forward to working with you.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Thank you, I look forward to it as well.

dialogue.origin: それではお時間になったので始めさせていただきますね。
dialogue.content: Alright, since it's time, let's begin.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは、相談員です。本日よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm the counselor. Thank you for meeting with me today.

dialogue.origin: 本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか。
dialogue.content: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: 親子関係のことです。
dialogue.content: It's about my parent-child relationship.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。具体的にどのようなことでお悩みでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. Could you tell me more specifically what's been troubling you?

dialogue.origin: 自分のことと子供のことのバランスが上手く取れなくて悩んでいます。
dialogue.content: I'm struggling to balance my own needs with those of my child.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。。。それはしんどいですよね。
dialogue.content: I see... That must be very difficult.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ご自身のことと、お子様のこと、具体的にはどのようなことでバランスをとれていないなと、お感じでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Could you elaborate on what specific aspects of your own life and your child's make it hard to find balance?

dialogue.origin: 自分の勉強と子供の将来のことなのですが
dialogue.content: It's about my own studies and my child's future.

dialogue.origin: とても意欲のある子で
dialogue.content: She's a very motivated child.

dialogue.origin: うんうん。そうなのですね。
dialogue.content: Mmm-hmm. I see.

dialogue.origin: 自分のことより子供のことを
dialogue.content: I feel like I should prioritize my child's needs over my own.

dialogue.origin: 優先すべきなのかと思っています。
dialogue.content: I feel like I should prioritize my child's needs over my own.

dialogue.origin: けれども自分のことも
dialogue.content: But I also want to work hard on my own goals.

dialogue.origin: 頑張りたいんです。
dialogue.content: But I also want to work hard on my own goals.

dialogue.origin: お子様を優先すべきとお思いだけど、ご自身の勉強もがんばられたいですよね。。。大切なお子様とご自身のこと、とても悩みますよね。
dialogue.content: So you feel you should prioritize your child, but you also want to work hard on your studies... It must be a real struggle, trying to decide between your precious child and yourself.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ちなみに、今お子様はおいくつなのですか？
dialogue.content: By the way, how old is your child now?

dialogue.origin: 12才です。
dialogue.content: She's 12.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。12歳というと、小学校6年生ということでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. So, that would be sixth grade in elementary school?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: これから勉強も大変ですし、多感な時期になられますよね？
dialogue.content: Studies will get more demanding from here, and it's a very sensitive time, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 多感な時期になられますよね。
dialogue.content: It's a very sensitive phase.

dialogue.origin: お子様のこと、いろいろご心配になられますよね。
dialogue.content: I'm sure you have many worries about your child.

dialogue.origin: はい。どんなことも頑張りたいという子なので
dialogue.content: Yes. She's the type who wants to give her best at everything,

dialogue.origin: 応援してあけたくなるんです。
dialogue.content: so it makes me want to support her.

dialogue.origin: 親からの応援は、お子さんも力が湧いてきますよね。
dialogue.content: Support from a parent really energizes a child, doesn't it?

dialogue.origin: ご相談者様は、とてもお子様のこと、大切に思われていらっしゃるのですね。
dialogue.content: You truly cherish your child, don't you?

dialogue.origin: はい。ただ小さい頃から2人の
dialogue.content: Yes. But since she was little, our bond has been so strong

dialogue.origin: 絆があまりに強かったので
dialogue.content: that our bond was so strong

dialogue.origin: 母親離れ出来ていない部分もあるんです。
dialogue.content: that in some ways, she hasn't become fully independent from me as her mother.

dialogue.origin: 絆が強い親子さんで、とても素敵ですよね。でも、ご相談者様は、母親離れできていないとお感じなのですね・・・
dialogue.content: Having a strong bond as a mother and child is a wonderful thing. But you feel that she hasn't become independent from you...

dialogue.origin: お子様が大切な反面、親離れできていないとお感じで、お辛いですよね。
dialogue.content: While you cherish your child, it must be painful to feel that she's not yet independent.

dialogue.origin: はい。ママとだとやる気が出る、楽しい、嬉しいと言ってきます。
dialogue.content: Yes. She says things like, 'When I'm with you, Mom, I feel motivated,' 'it's fun,' and 'I'm happy.'

dialogue.origin: 外ではしっかりしてるのですが
dialogue.content: She's very self-reliant when she's outside,

dialogue.origin: 家だととても甘えてきます。
dialogue.content: but at home, she's very affectionate and dependent on me.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。やる気が出るというのはお母さまとしては嬉しいですよね。
dialogue.content: I see. Hearing that she feels motivated with you must be heartwarming as a mother.

dialogue.origin: ちなみに、ご相談者様のご家族は、12歳のお子様と、他にどなたかいらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.content: By the way, besides your 12-year-old child, is there anyone else in your family?

dialogue.origin: 19才と17才の娘がいます。
dialogue.content: I have two other daughters, aged 19 and 17.

dialogue.origin: 三人の娘さんがいらっしゃるのですね！素敵ですね。12才の娘さんは末娘さんなのですね？
dialogue.content: So you have three daughters! That's wonderful. Your 12-year-old is the youngest, then?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 絆が深いということでしたが、末娘さんとの関係は上の娘さん二人と比べてどのように違うのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: You mentioned having a deep bond. How is your relationship with your youngest daughter different from your relationships with your two older daughters?

dialogue.origin: 末娘は生まれた直後から保育器に入ってるのでさえ
dialogue.content: My youngest... right after she was born, she was in an incubator.

dialogue.origin: 泣いている子で私と寝ると泣き止む子でだったので
dialogue.content: She was a child who cried a lot, but would stop when she slept with me.

dialogue.origin: 私の傍から離れず
dialogue.content: So she never left my side,

dialogue.origin: お手伝いや習い事を一生懸命やっていました。
dialogue.content: and she worked very hard helping around the house and with her lessons.

dialogue.origin: 上の2人は
dialogue.content: As for my two older daughters,

dialogue.origin: 自分からやりたいという感じではなかったので
dialogue.content: they weren't as self-motivated,

dialogue.origin: うんうん、
dialogue.content: Mmm-hmm,

dialogue.origin: 末っ子のことを一生懸命やっている感じでした。
dialogue.content: so I felt like I was pouring all my energy into my youngest.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。末娘さんは性格も一生懸命でご相談者様のお手伝いや勉強もやられていたら、可愛くてたくさん応援したくなりますよね。
dialogue.content: I see. With your youngest daughter having such a diligent personality, helping you and working hard on her studies, it's only natural that you'd find her endearing and want to support her so much.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです
dialogue.content: Exactly.

dialogue.origin: 大切だけど、大切にしすぎてしまって悩まれますよね。
dialogue.content: She's precious to you, but you're worried that you might be cherishing her too much. That must be a difficult feeling.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ここで少し今ままでのこと整理させていただいてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Would it be alright if I take a moment to summarize what we've discussed so far?

dialogue.origin: はいお願いします
dialogue.content: Yes, please do.

dialogue.origin: 12才になる末娘さんは生まれた時から、とても近い場所にいらっしゃって、勉強も手伝いもやる気のあるので、ご家族の中でも特別絆の深い存在でいらっしゃる。
dialogue.content: Your 12-year-old youngest daughter has been very close to you since birth, and because she's so motivated with her studies and chores, you share a special bond with her within the family.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 甘えん坊なところもまだあり、ご相談者様も親離れできないところがあると感じていらっしゃるのですよね。
dialogue.content: She still has a dependent side, and you also feel that she hasn't become independent from you as her mother. Is that correct?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ちなみに、ご自身の勉強のことと、お子様のことでバランスが取れないことに悩まれているとのことでしたが、どのような勉強をされていらっしゃるのですか？
dialogue.content: You mentioned earlier that you're struggling to balance your own studies with your child's needs. May I ask what you are studying?

dialogue.origin: 心理学です。
dialogue.content: Psychology.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね、ご自身のためにがんばられて素敵ですね。
dialogue.content: I see. It's wonderful that you're working hard for your own self-improvement.

dialogue.origin: ちなみに、勉強を始められたのは何かきっかけがあるのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: By the way, was there a specific reason or trigger that made you start studying it?

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 子供を生むまで自分の経験が
dialogue.content: Because before I had children, my experiences

dialogue.origin: 人を大切に出来ていなかったので
dialogue.content: made me feel that I wasn't able to truly care for people.

dialogue.origin: 人を
dialogue.content: So I came to want

dialogue.origin: 大切にしたいと思うようになったからです。
dialogue.content: to learn how to cherish others.

dialogue.origin: 人を大切にできていなかったとお感じだったのですね。。。とてもしんどかったですね。
dialogue.content: So you felt that you weren't able to cherish others... That must have been very painful for you.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: お話しいただいてありがとうございます。でもお子様を三人も愛情をもって大切に育てられて、頑張ってこられましたね。
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing that with me. But you have raised three children with love and care. You've worked so hard.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: そのようにご自身のために勉強をされはじめていらっしゃると思いますが、まだまだ子育てが大変な時期で、バランスをとるのは本当に難しいと思います。
dialogue.content: And now you've started studying for yourself, but I imagine it's incredibly difficult to find balance when you're still in the thick of raising children.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 12才ですし、家ではまだまだ甘えてよい年頃だと思います。
dialogue.content: At 12, I think it's still an age where it's perfectly fine to be dependent at home.

dialogue.origin: ちなみに、どのような点で親離れできていないなと、ご自身でお感じですか？
dialogue.content: By the way, in what specific ways do you feel that she hasn't become independent from you?

dialogue.origin: 友達ともよく遊び
dialogue.content: She plays with her friends a lot,

dialogue.origin: 自分をしっかり持っている子なので
dialogue.content: and she's a child who really knows her own mind,

dialogue.origin: 家にいる時の私への甘え方が
dialogue.content: so the way she depends on me at home—

dialogue.origin: 私自身、そう感じでしまっているのかもしれません。
dialogue.content: it might just be that I'm the one perceiving it that way.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、そうお感じなのですね。
dialogue.content: Mmm-hmm, so that's how it feels to you.

dialogue.origin: ご相談者様は、お子様を三人も子育てされていらっしゃって、特に末娘さんへの絆も深く、末娘さんの甘えが強すぎるんじゃないかとお感じなのですね。
dialogue.content: So, you've raised three children, you have a particularly deep bond with your youngest, and you're feeling that her dependence on you might be too strong.

dialogue.origin: 上2人の気持ちにも
dialogue.content: I also started to think about the feelings of my older two—

dialogue.origin: 末っ子ばかりいいな、ずるいという気持ちが
dialogue.content: that they might feel, 'The youngest gets all the attention, it's not fair,'

dialogue.origin: 出てしまったみたいなので
dialogue.content: and since those feelings started to come out,

dialogue.origin: 末っ子と距離を置くようにしました。
dialogue.content: I decided to put some distance between myself and my youngest.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、そうだったのですね。愛情を分散しなければと、距離を置かれてセーブされたのですね。。。それはお辛いですよね。
dialogue.content: I see, so that's what happened. You felt you had to distribute your affection more evenly, so you purposefully put some distance between you and held back... That must be very painful.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ご相談者様は、以前お子様ができるまで人を大切にできなかったとお感じでしたが、お子様を育てられてから、特に末娘さんにはとても愛情をたくさん注いでこられたのですよね。
dialogue.content: You felt that you couldn't truly cherish others before you had children, but after becoming a mother, you poured a great deal of love into them, especially your youngest daughter.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 一方で、いつか巣立っていくお子様へ、愛情をかけすぎてしまって親離れできないかもしれないとご自身でセーブして、不安を感じられているのかなと思いましたが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: On the other hand, I wonder if you're holding yourself back out of concern that giving too much love might make it hard for her to become independent when she eventually leaves the nest, and that this is creating anxiety for you. How does that resonate?

dialogue.origin: そうなんです...
dialogue.content: That's it exactly...

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、失ってしまうと思うと辛いですし、本当に不安ですよね。
dialogue.content: Yes, the thought of losing that bond is painful and truly anxiety-inducing, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: いつかは、物理的には、親子は離れていくと思いますが、親子の関係も絆もなくなるわけではないと思います。
dialogue.content: Someday, parents and children do physically separate, but I don't believe that the parent-child relationship or their bond disappears.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そして、まだまだ12才です、子育てをセーブしたり愛情を話したりせずに楽しまれる時間だと考えてはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: And she's still only 12. Perhaps you could think of this as a time to enjoy parenting, without holding back your affection or putting distance between you?

dialogue.origin: （すいません、お時間すぎてしまいましたが、もう10分ほど大丈夫でしょうか？）
dialogue.content: (Excuse me, I see we've gone over our time. Would you be available for another 10 minutes or so?)

dialogue.origin: すみません！11時からほかの相談者役として予約しているんです
dialogue.content: Oh, I'm sorry! I'm scheduled to act as a client for another session starting at 11.

dialogue.origin: （すいませんでした！！！！それではカウンセリングを終わらせていただきますね。中途半端ですいませんでした！またの機会によろしくお願いいたします。）
dialogue.content: (Oh, my apologies! In that case, let's wrap up the session here. I'm sorry for ending it so abruptly! I hope we can speak again another time.)

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました！
dialogue.content: Thank you very much!

dialogue.origin: こちらこそすみません！
dialogue.content: No, I'm sorry as well!

dialogue.origin: 本日はご相談にきていただいてありがとうございました。ご相談者様が自信をもって過ごせること祈っております。またの機会にいつでもどうぞよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Thank you for coming in for a consultation today. I hope you can move forward with confidence. Please feel free to reach out again anytime.

dialogue.origin: （ありがとうございました！）
dialogue.content: (Thank you!)

dialogue.origin: 励みになりました！
dialogue.content: This was very encouraging!

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ、どうもありがとうございました。これでカウンセリング終了させていただきますね。
dialogue.content: The pleasure was all mine, thank you very much. We'll conclude the counseling session now.

topic.sub: 親子関係のバランス問題
